metaTitle: We Install Govee Lights | 2026 Award Winner
metaDescription: We Install Govee Lights won our 2026 Permanent Outdoor Lighting award for Windsor, Ontario. App-controlled, weatherproof Govee Elite and Pro installs.
summary: We Install Govee Lights specializes in professional permanent outdoor Govee LED installations across Southwestern Ontario, using the brand's Elite and Pro product lines. Systems are app-controlled, voice-assistant compatible, and colour-matched to a home's fascia for a clean daytime appearance.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: We Install Govee Lights offers permanent Govee outdoor lighting, Govee Elite and Pro installation, and commercial property lighting. Rather than a general permanent lighting installer that works with multiple brands, this business focuses specifically on Govee's Elite and Pro product lines.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: Installations are described as app-controlled and compatible with Alexa and Google Assistant, using CSA-approved weatherproof hardware rated for Canadian winters. The company colour-matches hardware to a home's fascia for an invisible daytime profile and states most installs are completed in a single day, backed by a 5-year parts warranty.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One reviewer said the finished install made their home look stunning, with lights perfectly placed and controllable entirely from their phone, adding that neighbours had already asked who did the work. Another described switching from replacing traditional Christmas lights every year to a single permanent Govee install, now controlling colour changes by voice.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company is based in Windsor and serves Southwestern Ontario, with reviews specifically coming from as far as London and Kitchener. Confirm coverage for your specific location, since the stated service area is regional rather than Windsor-only.

strengths: Specializes specifically in the Govee Elite and Pro product lines rather than working across many lighting brands.
Colour-matches fixtures to fascia for a clean, near-invisible daytime look.
App and voice-assistant control through Alexa and Google Assistant.
Backed by a 5-year parts warranty, and most installs completed in a single day.
considerations: Specialization in one brand means less flexibility if you specifically want a different permanent lighting system; ask why they chose Govee if brand matters to you.
Best suited to homeowners comfortable with app-based, connected home lighting rather than simple always-on fixtures.
Not a fit if you need commercial-scale event or parade lighting; this business is focused on permanent property lighting.
Regional service area spans a wide part of Southwestern Ontario, so confirm scheduling and travel for your specific address.
bestFor: Homeowners tired of installing and removing traditional string lights every year
Anyone wanting app or voice-controlled colour-changing outdoor lighting
Homeowners who want fixtures invisible from the street during the day
Commercial properties wanting permanent accent lighting

faq.a: We Install Govee Lights was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top permanent outdoor lighting company serving the Windsor area, based on public services and reviews, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.a: Yes, systems are described as app-controlled and compatible with both Alexa and Google Assistant.

faq.a: The company states it uses CSA-approved weatherproof hardware rated for Canadian winters.
